title: Project charter and scope lock
objective: Turn the master brief into a one-page charter with operational definitions, constraints and a written list of what will NOT be claimed.
expected_output: charter.md, DECISIONS.csv, LOG.md, Zotero library, OSF stub.
checklist: [ ] Charter lists >= 12 explicit non-goals | [ ] Decision register has >= 5 entries | [ ] Q1-Q3 each have a falsifiable statement
fallback: If OSF registration is blocked, store the pre-analysis plan as a time-stamped Git tag and a Zenodo draft.

title: Literature protocol and first harvest
objective: Run a reproducible literature search and collect the first 120+ candidate papers into a tagged library.
expected_output: search_protocol.md, library of >= 120 screened candidates, PRISMA counts table.
checklist: [ ] Protocol file committed | [ ] >= 120 candidates tagged | [ ] Counts reproducible from exports
fallback: No database access: use OpenAlex API (free) with the same strings and store the JSON.

title: Evidence synthesis I: Pakistan and Sindh
objective: Read and tabulate what has been done in Sindh/Pakistan for floods, salinity, wetlands, drought, poverty and rural environmental monitoring.
checklist: [ ] Every row has a resolvable DOI/URL | [ ] Validation type filled for all rows | [ ] Gap list has >= 6 items
fallback: If full texts are unavailable, use institutional/ILL requests, authors' preprints, or abstract-only rows flagged 'abstract-only'.

title: Evidence synthesis II: methods and novelty matrix
objective: Review spatiotemporal forecasting, graph-based remote sensing, multimodal EO, uncertainty and spatial validation; produce the novelty matrix.
checklist: [ ] Novelty matrix has >= 8 rows with citations | [ ] search_log.csv has dates and hit counts | [ ] No unsupported 'first' claim
fallback: If few close works exist, report that as a search result (with log) and strengthen the benchmark framing.

title: Hypotheses, definitions and pre-analysis plan
objective: Freeze operational definitions (stress, persistence, recovery), hypotheses H1-H8 and the analysis plan BEFORE seeing any model results.
expected_output: pre_analysis_plan.md (v1.0), hypotheses.md, OSF registration or Git tag 'pap-v1'.
checklist: [ ] PAP lists locked test sets | [ ] Each hypothesis has a falsification criterion | [ ] Deviation protocol written
fallback: If definitions look infeasible later, amend through the deviation log rather than editing the PAP silently.

title: Software environment, GEE access and quotas
objective: Build a reproducible environment and verify Earth Engine and GPU access end to end.
checklist: [ ] Fresh env builds from file | [ ] GEE test export succeeds | [ ] PyG forward pass runs
fallback: PyG install fails: use CPU wheels or fall back to plain PyTorch sparse message passing (Day 75 fallback). No GPU: plan Kaggle/Colab sessions.
notes: Project vista-sindh registered (noncommercial); asset root live after first Code Editor visit

title: Weekly review 1 and repository scaffold
objective: Review week 1 against its outputs and create the repository skeleton, config system and data-card templates.
expected_output: GitHub repo (private), Makefile, configs/, templates, week1_review.md.
checklist: [ ] pre-commit passes | [ ] pytest runs (even if trivial) | [ ] Week-1 review file lists all outputs
fallback: No GitHub: use GitLab/Codeberg or a local bare repo and mirror later.

title: Dataset inventory and asset verification
objective: Verify every candidate dataset actually exists with the expected IDs, bands, dates and coverage over Sindh.
checklist: [ ] All 17 dataset groups verified or replaced | [ ] Date ranges recorded from the API, not memory | [ ] Licences listed
fallback: ID missing: search the Earth Engine data catalogue for the successor version; else download via the provider and upload as an asset.

title: Methodology blueprint and compute budget
objective: Write the end-to-end technical blueprint: data flow, tensor schema, experiment registry and compute budget.
checklist: [ ] Every artefact has path+schema | [ ] Compute budget lists fallback if over limit | [ ] Schema reviewed against Section 8
fallback: If chips look infeasible, plan the Tier-2 fallback (zonal statistics + optional embeddings) from the start.

title: MILESTONE 1: protocol v1.0 and smoke test
objective: Close Phase 1: freeze the protocol and prove the stack works with a 5-village end-to-end run.
checklist: [ ] Smoke test passes from a clean clone | [ ] Protocol frozen and tagged | [ ] Milestone-1 file list 100% present
fallback: If the smoke test fails on GEE quotas, run with 1 point and extend later; do not skip the leakage assertion.
notes: Smoke test passed (MAE 0.032, 0/360 missing); protocol v1.0 document not written

title: PBS Mouza Census 2020: acquire and parse Sindh tables
objective: Obtain the PBS Sindh Mouza Census 2020 provincial report and turn its tehsil/district tables into machine-readable files; submit record-level data requests.
checklist: [ ] Extracted totals reproduce PBS totals | [ ] Request letters sent and logged | [ ] Unit memo states how deh/settlement are used
fallback: Parsing fails: key tables manually into CSV for talukas only (about 120 rows each) and double-entry check.

title: Administrative boundaries and crosswalks
objective: Assemble and harmonise province, district, taluka and union-council boundaries and crosswalk them to PBS names.
checklist: [ ] No invalid geometries | [ ] 100% PBS talukas matched or flagged | [ ] District history table covers 2017-2025
fallback: Boundary mismatch: use the most recent OCHA/OSM layer as the spine and record unmatched PBS rows as 'unmapped'.

title: Settlement evidence layers: footprints, OSM, GeoNames
objective: Ingest every free settlement-evidence layer for Sindh and quantify each against PBS counts.
checklist: [ ] Each source loaded for all talukas | [ ] Counts per taluka tabulated vs PBS | [ ] Licence notes saved
fallback: Footprints too heavy: process by taluka tiles; or use GHSL built-up connected components as the fallback settlement source.
notes: Raw layers in hand: Open Buildings 125 talukas, OSM shapefiles, GeoNames, evidence table; parquet + coverage-by-taluka not done

title: Weekly review 2 and pilot settlement clustering
objective: Review week 2 and test settlement-polygon construction on three contrasting pilot talukas.
checklist: [ ] Sensitivity table for 3 pilots | [ ] Visual QC notes for 90 clusters | [ ] Chosen parameters justified
fallback: If clusters are unstable, use two-tier definition (hamlet vs village) and carry both into the inventory.
notes: Pilot clustering for Mithi/Sanghar/Shah Bunder (8,245 settlements); sensitivity analysis not done

title: Province-wide settlement polygons
objective: Generate settlement polygons for all of Sindh with attributes and per-taluka QC.
checklist: [ ] All talukas processed | [ ] 0 invalid geometries | [ ] Settlement counts per taluka reported
fallback: Memory limits: shrink tile size; use DuckDB spatial or Dask-GeoPandas.

title: Names: attach, normalise and transliterate
objective: Attach names from OSM/GeoNames/PBS lists to settlement polygons using a documented normalisation pipeline.
checklist: [ ] Raw names preserved | [ ] >= 1 normalised key per named polygon | [ ] Naming coverage table by district
fallback: Few names available: keep unnamed settlements (ID-only) -- the model does not need names.

title: Deh boundaries and assignment
objective: Obtain deh (mouza) polygons if available and assign settlements to dehs; otherwise create documented proxies.
checklist: [ ] Assignment rule documented | [ ] Coverage % computed per district | [ ] Fallback path documented if no deh data
fallback: No deh polygons: Voronoi partition within taluka/UC; PBS aggregates remain taluka-level references.

title: Village identifier system and registry
objective: Create persistent, name-independent identifiers and a registry with crosswalks.
checklist: [ ] 0 duplicate VIDs | [ ] IDs identical after rerun | [ ] Crosswalks load without orphans
fallback: H3 not installable: use geohash (level 9) + counter.

title: Duplicate detection and resolution
objective: Resolve duplicated names and duplicated detections of the same settlement.
checklist: [ ] Merge log complete | [ ] 300 pairs reviewed | [ ] Post-merge uniqueness tests pass
fallback: If review is too slow, review a stratified 150 and fix thresholds by precision on that sample.

title: Missing coordinates and quality classes
objective: Handle records without coordinates and assign a coordinate quality class to every village.
expected_output: quality_class column in registry, unmatched_records.csv, quality_summary.csv.
checklist: [ ] Every VID has a class | [ ] Threshold tuned on verified pairs | [ ] Excluded share reported by district
fallback: Poor matching: raise the threshold and accept lower coverage; never force matches.

title: Weekly review 3 and validation sample design
objective: Review week 3 and design the independent spatial validation of the inventory.
checklist: [ ] 600+150 units sampled with seed logged | [ ] Protocol has class definitions | [ ] 100-unit second-rater subset marked
fallback: Basemap unavailable: use Sentinel-2 10 m only and accept coarser omission/commission estimates.

title: Execute inventory validation
objective: Perform the manual validation and compute detection and matching accuracy with uncertainty.
checklist: [ ] All 750 units labelled | [ ] CIs computed | [ ] Error taxonomy with >= 5 error types
depends_on: Day 21. If time runs short, finish the 300-unit core sample and flag the remainder as 'planned'.

title: Village zones: core, resource and connectivity
objective: Implement and test the three-zone geometry for every village.
checklist: [ ] Zones exist for every Q1-Q2 village | [ ] No resource zone overlaps a foreign core | [ ] Area statistics reported
fallback: Memory/time: compute zones per taluka; if Voronoi is slow, use rasterised nearest-seed allocation at 30 m.
notes: Core + resource zones for pilot (16,489); connectivity zones not built

title: Village atlas v0.1 and coverage report
objective: Generate the first atlas and a province-wide coverage report.
checklist: [ ] Coverage table for all districts | [ ] Definitions written | [ ] 20 atlas sheets visually checked
fallback: Atlas rendering slow: restrict to 10 pilot districts.

title: MILESTONE 2: inventory freeze v1.0
objective: Close Phase 2 with a frozen, documented village inventory and decision memo.
expected_output: village_inventory_v1.0 (+ zones), data_dictionary.md, decision_memo_inventory.md, tag v0.2.0.
checklist: [ ] Registry passes all unit tests | [ ] N and coverage reported from files | [ ] Milestone-2 file list complete
fallback: If validation shows poor recall in some districts, label them 'low confidence' and train models only where confidence is adequate.

title: GEE zonal-statistics framework
objective: Build a reusable, fault-tolerant Earth Engine pipeline that turns any image collection into village-zone time series.
checklist: [ ] Pilot export reproduces a local rasterio check within tolerance | [ ] Retry logic tested by forced failure | [ ] Manifest tracks all tasks
fallback: Asset upload too large: split by district; or avoid assets by sending geometries in chunks from Python (slower).

title: Sentinel-2 preprocessing and cloud masking
objective: Create analysis-ready monthly Sentinel-2 composites with explicit cloud and quality handling.
checklist: [ ] Valid-observation count exported | [ ] Threshold justified on a sample | [ ] No negative-reflectance artefacts
fallback: Cloud Score+ unavailable: use COPERNICUS/S2_CLOUD_PROBABILITY (s2cloudless, prob < 40) + SCL mask.

title: Weekly review 4 and Sentinel-2 province run (batch 1)
objective: Review week 4, then launch the province-wide Sentinel-2 extraction in batches.
checklist: [ ] Batch-1 tasks complete or queued | [ ] Spot checks within tolerance | [ ] Quota log updated
fallback: Quota hit: reduce to the 2019-2025 window first, then extend; or restrict to the resource zone only.

title: Sentinel-2 province run (batch 2) and QC
objective: Finish Sentinel-2 extraction and quality-control the full table.
checklist: [ ] Row counts match expected zones x months | [ ] Masks stored | [ ] Dataset hash logged
fallback: Missing years: carry as NaN; Landsat and MODIS provide the long record.

title: Landsat Collection 2 harmonisation
objective: Build consistent 30 m Landsat series (TM/ETM+/OLI) for 2000-2025.
checklist: [ ] Overlap regression R^2 and bias reported | [ ] SLC-off pixels masked | [ ] Season definition in configs
fallback: Harmonisation unstable: use NDVI only from OLI-era plus MODIS for pre-2013; or analyse sensor-specific series with sensor dummies.

title: Landsat extraction and cross-sensor calibration
objective: Extract Landsat zonal series and quantify agreement with Sentinel-2 and MODIS.
checklist: [ ] Overlap statistics by ecoregion | [ ] Primary series chosen and justified | [ ] Landsat table QC'd
fallback: Landsat export too heavy: restrict Landsat to seasonal composites and resource zones.

title: Sentinel-1 SAR processing
objective: Create consistent Sentinel-1 backscatter and water-sensitive layers for 2015-2025.
checklist: [ ] Revisit count stored | [ ] Water prototype visually checked on the 2022 flood | [ ] Orbit policy documented
fallback: Orbit mixing unavoidable: add orbit as covariate and use relative (change) metrics only.

title: Dynamic World integration
objective: Extract land-cover probability series from Dynamic World and define their permitted use.
checklist: [ ] Probabilities within [0,1] | [ ] Seasonality plausible vs NDVI | [ ] Policy written
fallback: Coverage gaps: build crop/water fractions directly from S2 thresholds.

title: MODIS vegetation, LST and ET products
objective: Extract MODIS NDVI/EVI, LST, and optional ET/GPP time series with correct QA and timing.
checklist: [ ] Availability date column present | [ ] GF products flagged 'non-causal' | [ ] LST day/night plausible ranges
fallback: QA too restrictive: use SummaryQA 0-1 and report coverage.

title: Weekly review 5 and CHIRPS rainfall
objective: Review week 5 and build the rainfall series.
checklist: [ ] SPI series have mean about 0 and SD about 1 on baseline | [ ] Zero-rain handling documented | [ ] Review file complete
fallback: No gauges: compare CHIRPS with ERA5-Land precipitation only and state the limitation.

title: ERA5-Land climate variables and SPEI
objective: Extract reanalysis temperature, soil moisture, PET and compute SPEI.
checklist: [ ] PET sign verified | [ ] SPEI mean about 0 on baseline | [ ] Cell-id column stored
fallback: ERA5-Land PET problematic: use Hargreaves PET from t2m range if needed.

title: Surface water: JRC GSW and S1/S2 extension
objective: Create a consistent surface-water series and quantify the gap after 2021.
checklist: [ ] Agreement metrics reported | [ ] Source flag in table | [ ] Post-2021 policy written
fallback: Poor agreement: restrict target construction to the S1/S2 era (2016-2025) and use GSW only as a static covariate.

title: DEM, terrain and hydrology covariates
objective: Derive static terrain and drainage covariates for all villages.
checklist: [ ] No NaN for Q1-Q2 villages | [ ] Units documented | [ ] DEM choice justified
fallback: HAND unreliable: use distance to river/canal and elevation above local minimum in a 5 km window.

title: Exposure, accessibility and settlement context layers
objective: Add slow-varying context covariates: population, built-up, accessibility, optional night lights.
checklist: [ ] Epistemic type column complete | [ ] No future-epoch interpolation | [ ] Missing values summarised
fallback: WorldPop missing for some years: use GHSL only.

title: MILESTONE 3: harmonised environmental dataset v0.9
objective: Close Phase 3: assemble all extractions into one aligned store and write the data cards.
checklist: [ ] Alignment tests pass | [ ] Completeness matrices produced | [ ] Milestone-3 file list complete
fallback: If one product fails (e.g. S1), proceed without it and register the loss as an ablation condition.

title: Indicator catalogue and data model
objective: Specify every indicator formally before computing it: formula, inputs, units, normalisation, limits.
checklist: [ ] Spec covers all 12 families | [ ] Causal-fill unit test passes | [ ] Registry reproduces 5-village outputs
fallback: Spec too ambitious: drop agricultural proxies beyond cropping intensity.

title: Weekly review 6 and spectral indices
objective: Review week 6 and compute vegetation and water indices consistently across sensors.
checklist: [ ] Band maps documented | [ ] Consistency table complete | [ ] Range checks pass
fallback: Index inconsistent across sensors: use sensor-specific indices with sensor covariates and never mix within one training series without adjustment.

title: Seasonal normalisation framework
objective: Implement and compare normalisation methods that produce anomalies without leakage.
checklist: [ ] Climatology uses only years <= 2017 | [ ] Shrinkage implemented and tested | [ ] Default chosen with evidence
fallback: Short-baseline instability: pool by ecoregion x month; report village-level anomalies with wider caution.

title: Resource-zone sensitivity and vegetation productivity
objective: Test resource-zone radius choices and build seasonal productivity indicators.
checklist: [ ] r_max chosen from data | [ ] Phenology plausible on 20 samples | [ ] Anomalies computed with train-only baseline
fallback: Radius ambiguous: keep 2 km (3-5 km in desert) and report sensitivity as a limitation.

title: Rainfall anomaly indicators
objective: Finalise rainfall and drought-forcing indicators.
checklist: [ ] Baseline SPI moments ok | [ ] Lag table for all ecoregions | [ ] Disagreement map saved
fallback: Rainfall products disagree: use both as separate inputs and include disagreement as a feature.

title: Land-surface temperature anomalies
objective: Build LST and heat-related anomaly indicators with explicit caveats.
checklist: [ ] Valid-count column present | [ ] z-scores finite | [ ] Caveats documented
fallback: Gaps in night LST: use day LST only.

title: Surface-water persistence and wetland dynamics
objective: Compute water persistence and seasonality indicators, with checks on known wetlands.
checklist: [ ] Known wetlands show expected persistence | [ ] tau sensitivity table | [ ] Anomaly series causal
fallback: Water signal too noisy: use a persistence class (3 levels) instead of continuous values.

title: Flood frequency and persistence
objective: Create flood indicators from Sentinel-1/Optical data and validate them against independent event products.
checklist: [ ] 2022 event agreement metrics reported | [ ] Revisit normalisation implemented | [ ] Pre-2015 flagged low-confidence
fallback: No external flood layer: validate by visual interpretation of 100 village-year samples.

title: Weekly review 7 and agricultural activity proxies
objective: Review week 7 and build agricultural-activity proxies without claiming yield.
checklist: [ ] Prominence sensitivity table | [ ] PBS comparison Spearman rho reported | [ ] Limitations noted
fallback: Cloud limits Kharif peaks: use S1 as the Kharif cross-check and flag cloud-limited seasons.

title: Settlement expansion and contraction signals
objective: Quantify built-up change around villages with noise controls.
checklist: [ ] Noise floor computed | [ ] Classes assigned | [ ] Disclaimer in data card
fallback: Signal weak: keep as static context (built fraction) rather than a dynamic indicator.

title: Environmental stress indicators (event-based)
objective: Define and compute separate stress events per indicator, without any composite score.
checklist: [ ] Four event types computed | [ ] Sensitivity grid saved | [ ] No composite variable exists
fallback: Thresholds produce degenerate frequencies: widen to percentile-based events (e.g. lowest quintile) and record the change.

title: Environmental recovery indicators
objective: Define recovery and resilience metrics from stress spells.
checklist: [ ] Censoring flag stored | [ ] Spell table matches stress events | [ ] Class counts reported
fallback: Few spells in some regions: pool by ecoregion for statistics, keep village labels where defined.

title: Indicator validation I: internal and cross-sensor
objective: Quantify reliability of indicators before using them as inputs or labels.
checklist: [ ] Noise estimates for >= 6 indicators | [ ] Unreliable indicators listed | [ ] Sensitivity summary complete
fallback: Too few invariants: use stable-reference polygons by ecoregion.

title: Indicator validation II: external reference data
objective: Compare indicators with independent reference observations at the scale where they exist.
checklist: [ ] Rho with CIs for >= 5 comparisons | [ ] Failed comparisons reported | [ ] Visual sample labelled
fallback: Reference tables unusable: rely on visual validation and published event maps; state the gap.

title: MILESTONE 4: indicator dataset v1.0 and handbook
objective: Close Phase 4: freeze indicators, thresholds and the indicator handbook.
checklist: [ ] Reproduction check passes for 3 indicators | [ ] Config frozen with hash | [ ] Milestone-4 file list complete
fallback: If some indicators remain unreliable, drop them from the model and list them as exploratory.

title: Weekly review 8 and exploratory analysis with ecological regions
objective: Review week 8, explore distributions, and define ecological regions used for stratification and transfer tests.
checklist: [ ] k chosen with stability evidence | [ ] Ecoregion map produced | [ ] Named-region cross-tab saved
fallback: Unstable clusters: use named agro-ecological zones from literature and assign by taluka.

title: Long-term trend analysis
objective: Estimate trends per village and indicator with proper autocorrelation and multiplicity control.
checklist: [ ] FDR applied | [ ] Sensor-artefact check done | [ ] Effect sizes reported
fallback: Too many insignificant trends: report regional medians with bootstrap CIs.

title: Seasonal decomposition
objective: Decompose series to quantify seasonality and residual dynamics; separate descriptive from forecasting use.
checklist: [ ] Strength metrics for all villages | [ ] Causal variant tested for no look-ahead | [ ] Plots for 10 villages
fallback: STL fails on sparse series: use monthly climatology + AR(1) residual summaries.

title: Persistent stress detection
objective: Detect persistent stress with explicit rules and statistical alternatives.
checklist: [ ] Surrogate test completed | [ ] k-sensitivity table | [ ] HMM comparison reported
depends_on: Days 51-52. HMM unstable: use rule-based only and note the limitation.

title: Recovery trajectory identification
objective: Characterise recovery after stress using survival analysis and trajectory classes.
checklist: [ ] Censoring handled | [ ] PH assumption checked | [ ] Class counts by region
fallback: lifelines unavailable: use statsmodels PHReg or a discrete-time logistic hazard.

title: Change-point detection
objective: Detect abrupt shifts in environmental series with false-positive control.
checklist: [ ] Sensor-event overlap flagged | [ ] Stability metric reported | [ ] Break counts per region
fallback: Too many breaks: increase penalty or use annual aggregates only.

title: Environmental clustering and typology
objective: Create an interpretable typology of village trajectories.
checklist: [ ] Stability ARI reported | [ ] Test-period data not used for cluster fitting used in models | [ ] Maps produced
fallback: Poor stability: reduce to 3-4 broad types.

title: Weekly review 9 and spatial autocorrelation
objective: Review week 9 and quantify spatial dependence to design the validation blocks.
checklist: [ ] Range estimated per target | [ ] Block size/buffer decision logged | [ ] Hotspot maps saved
fallback: Variogram unreliable: use a fixed 50 km block with 10 km buffer and test sensitivity (25/100 km).

title: Regional comparisons and target definition
objective: Compare regions and districts statistically and finalise the forecasting targets.
checklist: [ ] Windows disjoint test passes | [ ] Class balance reported | [ ] Variance partition table saved
fallback: Target too rare: merge T4 into a 'wet-season inundation anomaly' regression.

title: MILESTONE 5: forecasting dataset v1.0 and splits
objective: Create leakage-audited training/validation/test datasets and freeze the split manifest.
checklist: [ ] Leakage tests all pass | [ ] Split manifest hashed | [ ] Milestone-5 file list complete
fallback: Dataset too large: subsample training villages by stratified block sampling; never subsample test blocks.

title: Evaluation harness and data loaders
objective: Build the PyTorch data pipeline and metric library with automated leakage tests.
checklist: [ ] All tests pass | [ ] Loader deterministic given seed | [ ] Metrics verified against sklearn on toy data
fallback: Chips too heavy: skip chip loader; keep zonal-statistics inputs (Tier 2).

title: Baselines 1-2: climatology, persistence, autoregression
objective: Implement and score the simplest baselines.
checklist: [ ] Climatology uses train years only | [ ] Skill scores computed | [ ] Horizon-wise table complete
fallback: AR too heavy per village: fit per ecoregion with village offsets.

title: Baselines 3-4: Random Forest and XGBoost
objective: Train tabular tree models with proper blocked validation and explainability.
checklist: [ ] Blocked tuning logs saved | [ ] No neighbour-label features | [ ] SHAP stability checked
fallback: Compute-limited: use LightGBM or reduce trials to 20.

title: LSTM forecaster
objective: Train a sequence model and compare with tree baselines.
checklist: [ ] 3 seeds finished | [ ] Training stable (no NaN) | [ ] Validation-only reporting
fallback: GPU unavailable: reduce hidden size to 64, batch 256, train on subset; or use GRU.

title: Weekly review 10 and Temporal Transformer
objective: Review week 10 and implement the Temporal Transformer encoder.
checklist: [ ] Padding mask verified by test | [ ] 3 seeds finished | [ ] Comparison table complete
fallback: Overfitting: smaller d_model (64), fewer layers (2), stronger dropout (0.3).

title: Village graph construction
objective: Build the multi-relational village graph from proximity, roads, drainage and irrigation data, with reliability tests.
checklist: [ ] Graph connected statistics reported | [ ] Reliability audit done | [ ] No outcome-derived edges
fallback: Irrigation/drainage data poor: use proximity + road graph (Tier 2 fallback).

title: Graph neural network baseline
objective: Train GraphSAGE/GCN/GAT baselines with inductive spatial hold-out.
checklist: [ ] Edge-shuffle control run | [ ] Test labels never in message passing | [ ] Seeds >= 3
fallback: PyG mini-batching unstable: precompute neighbour-aggregated features and use MLP (graph-free approximation).

title: Spatial feature encoder and chip pipeline
objective: Decide and build the spatial encoder: CNN, ViT-tiny, or zonal-statistics (+ optional embeddings).
checklist: [ ] Chip counts and sizes logged | [ ] Encoder forward pass tested | [ ] Leakage rule for embeddings in code
fallback: Chips infeasible: Tier 2 (zonal statistics only) becomes the primary spatial encoder.

title: Climate encoder and cross-modal attention fusion
objective: Implement the climate branch and fusion module with ablation switches.
checklist: [ ] Shape tests pass | [ ] Flags switch components off cleanly | [ ] Parameter counts logged
fallback: Cross-attention unstable: replace by concatenation + MLP.

title: Village Graph Attention Network integration
objective: Integrate the graph attention module into the multimodal network, with end-to-end and two-stage training modes.
checklist: [ ] Both modes run | [ ] Memory profile logged | [ ] Leakage test passes with graph
fallback: GAT too slow: use GraphSAGE mean aggregator or precomputed neighbour pooling.

title: Multivariate heads and uncertainty
objective: Implement regression/classification heads and a layered uncertainty system.
checklist: [ ] Coverage test on toy data near nominal | [ ] Ensemble inference script runs | [ ] API documented
fallback: Ensembles too costly: use 3 members or snapshot ensembles.

title: Weekly review 11 and full model assembly
objective: Review week 11 and assemble VISTA-Net end to end with sanity checks.
checklist: [ ] Tiny-batch overfit passes | [ ] All modules receive gradients | [ ] Pilot trains without NaN
fallback: Debug loop too long: freeze modules and add them one at a time (progressive assembly).

title: Hyper-parameter selection
objective: Select hyper-parameters with a fixed budget and blocked validation only.
checklist: [ ] Equal-effort rule documented | [ ] Search logs saved | [ ] Best configs hashed
fallback: Compute limited: tune only learning rate, hidden size, dropout and keep others fixed.

title: Full training runs on primary split
objective: Train all eight model classes with final configs and seeds on the primary split and prepare the CV job queue.
checklist: [ ] 8 model classes x 3 seeds trained | [ ] Registry complete | [ ] Job queue ready
fallback: Time shortage: reduce seeds to 2 for the baselines and keep 3 for the proposed model.

title: MILESTONE 6: model zoo frozen
objective: Close Phase 6: freeze the final candidates and choose the reporting architecture using the one-standard-error rule.
checklist: [ ] Selection rule applied and documented | [ ] Model cards complete | [ ] Milestone-6 file list complete
fallback: If VISTA-Net fails to train reliably, ship Tier-2 (tabular + temporal + optional GAT) as the main model.

title: Spatially blocked cross-validation
objective: Run all models through 5-fold spatially blocked cross-validation with buffers.
checklist: [ ] All folds complete | [ ] Block-bootstrap CIs present | [ ] Leakage-inflation figure produced
fallback: Compute short: run 3 folds for neural models and 5 for baselines, state it.

title: District-held-out and ecological-region transfer
objective: Test generalisation to entire unseen districts and ecological regions.
checklist: [ ] LODO for >= 10 districts | [ ] Transfer matrix complete | [ ] Worst-case districts listed
fallback: Compute limit: LODO for baselines + final model only; others in supplement 'planned'.

title: Temporal holdout and extreme-event testing
objective: Evaluate on the locked test years and on event-withheld experiments.
checklist: [ ] Test set evaluated exactly once | [ ] Event-withheld experiments run | [ ] Extreme vs normal skill table
fallback: If runs fail, rerun with identical configs and log the deviation; never tune against the test result.

title: Weekly review 12 and ablation studies
objective: Review week 12 and run the pre-registered ablation suite.
checklist: [ ] All pre-registered ablations run | [ ] Holm-adjusted p/CI reported | [ ] Component ranking by target
fallback: Too many ablations: prioritise graph, fusion, uncertainty, S1, climate; list the rest as 'not run'.

title: Error analysis
objective: Diagnose where and why the models fail.
checklist: [ ] Residual Moran's I reported | [ ] Failure gallery of 30 villages | [ ] Error vs n_valid analysis
fallback: Imagery gallery heavy: use thumbnails from S2 composites only.

title: Uncertainty calibration
objective: Evaluate and, if needed, recalibrate predictive uncertainty under spatial and temporal shift.
checklist: [ ] Coverage by region reported | [ ] Recalibration uses calibration blocks only | [ ] Sparsification curves saved
fallback: If calibration is poor, report uncalibrated and calibrated results side by side and restrict the claim.

title: Out-of-distribution detection and area of applicability
objective: Assess whether the model can flag where it should not be trusted.
checklist: [ ] AUROC for error detection reported | [ ] AoA map produced | [ ] Masking rule defined
fallback: OOD scores uninformative: rely on ensemble variance and valid-observation masks.

title: Comparison across ecological regions
objective: Compare performance by ecoregion, target and horizon, including regions where skill is absent.
checklist: [ ] All regions covered | [ ] No-skill regions flagged | [ ] CIs present
fallback: Region sizes too small: merge adjacent regions and note it.

title: Independent validation against reference observations
objective: Validate predictions and indicators against independent data not used for training.
